resources.string: Read and accept the notice to continue
Offline Whisper model is available locally and verified before loading. Enable it in Settings if needed. Microphone permission is requested when recording starts. Typed input is ready.
System speech provider is available; installed language support is not guaranteed. Permission is requested when recording starts. Typed input is ready.
No local model or system speech provider is available. Typed input remains ready. No fake download is performed.
Patient languages
Input languages; interface, translation target and assessment result languages are selected separately.
Offline speech model
Small had Arabic accuracy errors; Medium needs more time and RAM. Both are local. Review the transcript.
Local multilingual speech recognition with the selected model and original recorder controls. Audio stays on-device. First use prepares and verifies the model.
Local model is not ready. Use Prepare selected Whisper model in Settings; typed input remains available.
Optional local translation
Optional local translation of speech or written text. Known meaning errors; default OFF. Only the reviewed original is sent for assessment.
Translation language
Prepare translation models
Selected ML Kit language models: about 30 MB each over Wi-Fi. Some catalog languages require NLLB. Google receives SDK metrics, not input text or translation.
Developer/Test settings
Source recorder / VAD (experimental)

16 kHz capture with sensitivity, silence and pre-roll. With Offline Whisper disabled, recognition uses the system provider and may send audio online. That provider failed the emulator diagnostic. Android 13+.
Synthetic scenarios, backend address and temporary access token.
interface language
Not available —
Enable Offline Whisper or Source recorder / VAD in Settings to use the restored local volume threshold. Android SpeechRecognizer alone does not expose this control.

The original low-quality translation-language catalog requires NLLB and is not implemented. Bundled Whisper recognizes the four selected speech languages independently; no translation-quality toggle is simulated.
Playback uses the highest-quality installed offline voice. The original custom quality catalog is not available; no quality toggle is simulated.
Enable Offline Whisper or Source recorder / VAD in Settings to use local silence detection. The system-provider timeout alone is not equivalent.
The local pre-roll buffer is available with Offline Whisper or Source recorder / VAD enabled in Settings. Android SpeechRecognizer alone does not expose it.
